# Battle music: licence and source

**File:** `battle_loop.ogg` (Ogg Vorbis, 44.1 kHz stereo, 38.4 s seamless loop, 100 BPM)

**Title:** BrainSpeed IQ — Battle Loop

**Type:** Instrumental cyber / synthwave arcade loop. No vocals, no spoken words, no lyrics.

**Source:** Original composition and synthesis, generated by
`tools/audio/generate_battle_loop.py` from sine, saw, and square oscillators,
filtered noise, and envelopes. The script uses no samples, recordings, or
third-party melodies, and it is deterministic. Re-running it reproduces the
same file.

**Licence:** [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
(public-domain dedication). You may copy, modify, distribute, and use the track,
including commercially, without attribution. Attribution is not required, but
the credit above is kept for transparency.

**Copyright status:** No third-party copyrighted material is included. No
royalties or licence fees apply.

**Replacing the track:** If you swap in a different recording, update this file
with its title, author, source URL, and licence text. Only use tracks whose
licence allows commercial use inside an app and does not require attribution
you cannot provide. Keep the file under `assets/audio/` and update
`AppConfig.battleMusicAsset` if the name changes.
